properties.name: LYNX Microtransit (CATS LYNX)
properties.note: Service zone in Baker; operator is county transit agency (CATS). CATS also runs 'CATS on Demand' whose relationship to LYNX is unclear; scoped to LYNX microtransit only.

properties.name: Move Metairie On-Demand Zone
properties.note: Service limited to Metairie Road District within Jefferson Parish; Metairie is not an incorporated city but a community within Jefferson Parish. Scoped to Jefferson Parish (containing unit).

properties.name: River Parishes Transit Authority (RPTA) On-Demand Service
properties.units: St. Charles Parish; St. James Parish; St. John the Baptist Parish
properties.note: All three parishes explicitly named in service area. Booking portal confirms on-demand service; pre-booking requirements and fixed schedule window not fully clarified.

properties.name: SporTran OnDemand
properties.note: Multiple zone-based service areas in Shreveport-Bossier City metro; exact zone boundaries not specified in available sources. Scoped to both cities.

properties.name: St. Landry Parish CAA Transit
properties.note: Primary service in St. Landry Parish (Opelousas area); trips extend into Lafayette Parish and neighboring parishes as scheduling permits. Scoped to primary parish.
